_comment: C0-16 正文英译 · kagi（2026-10-25）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（perplexity/andi/metaso），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [perplexity, andi, metaso, chatgpt]，键按正文链接行对齐=3）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: A self-built search index (Kagi's self-built index is the core narrative) + FastGPT-style LLM answer layers (multiple models switchable, official product surface); the "search is the substance, AI is the add-on" ordering is the reverse of most AI search products.
axes.runtime: Web (kagi.com) + browser extension + Mini Bar (official product line); Kagi FastGPT/FastGPT-style Q&A on the cloud; the search index self-built.
axes.local_files: Search history can optionally be localized / zero-retention mode (official privacy narrative: no tracking, no profiling); no other local data surfaces officially stated seen.
axes.background: Search returns instantly; no official task queue or "keep-running-after-shutdown" style background task surface seen (not verified item by item).
axes.tools: Ad-free search (the signature), Teclis/Exa-style "search first, then LLM reads full texts" answer lines (official product surface), Universal Summarizer (URL/video/document summarization), translation; **the privacy promise is one of the product's main axes** (no-tracking narrative).
axes.context: No conversation-memory selling point — search is organized per session; cross-session memory and profiling not verified to an official statement (the privacy posture instead stresses not tracking).
axes.permissions: Subscription-first (D9: pricing not collected); **"no tracking, no selling data" is the official privacy narrative** — terms-level landing not verified item by item; paying for privacy is its product logic.
axes.fit: Fits: users willing to pay for an ad-free/untracked search experience, wanting "search + full-text reading" style answers (Teclis line), tracking-sensitive users. Does not fit: free users (no free tier as the lead), mainland-direct-sensitive (direct 200 reachable but payments follow overseas conventions), wanting Chinese retrieval as the mainstay.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Long-tail query coverage gap: self-built index vs Google/Bing**
- **Teclis "search then read full text" answers vs Perplexity's quality**
- **Actual verification that zero-retention mode takes effect** (history-behavior observation)
unknowns:
- Self-built index size and update frequency (no official statement verified)
- The currently switchable-model list for each answer line (not inventoried item by item)
- The terms-level landing of the privacy promises (not verified item by item)
- Actual retrieval quality for Chinese queries (not measured)
related: Ordering contrast: Perplexity is an AI answer with search attached, Kagi is search with AI answers attached.
Also privacy-oriented AI search: Andi is free + AI answers directly, Kagi is subscription + self-built index.
Also "no ads, straight to results" slogans: Metaso is Chinese-leaning free + membership, Kagi is English-leaning subscription.
